method: Four fresh-context agents read only the exported live task schema, used real plugin handlers, state methods and Scheme interpreter with a temporary file workspace, then reported post-mortems. The revised fixture shares the production error formatter; separate tests execute the actual session adapter.
cohort: One inherited model, four clean-room sessions; no cross-lineage validation.
limitations: Small directional probe. The example matches the fixture; no claim of generalization or reduced call count.

Cold scenarios both allowed six calls; recovery baseline allowed six, revised eight (seven used). Baseline received two extra calls after the generic error wrapper changed; those two calls are excluded here.
Fixture does not model session authorization or verbosity; actual session integration tests cover those boundaries.

surface_before.name: task__create
surface_before.description: Create a task with pending status and return its taskId. The harness manages status; completion requires task__validate, not a completed argument. The validationProgram is saved at creation and cannot be replaced. It must inspect current project state through files, tests, or a :readonly agent/ask using the task requirements, then call (tasks/write-completion-verdict ok comments). Returning #t or (list #t "…") is not a stamp. ;; use one-shot for schema-constrained responses

surface_before.name: task__start
surface_before.description: Start a task and return its subject and activationBrief. Only one task can be active; any previously active task returns to pending. Starting an already-active task changes nothing.

surface_before.name: task__drop
surface_before.description: Drop a task and save the reason. Completed tasks cannot be dropped. Dropping an already-dropped task changes nothing. Returns no value.

surface_before.name: task__after
surface_before.description: Add a prerequisite: taskId waits until after is completed. Does not start either task. Returns no value.

surface_before.name: task__validate
surface_before.description: Validate the active task using the validationProgram saved at creation; no replacement program is accepted. That program must call (tasks/write-completion-verdict ok comments) after checking current project state. The tool returns that pair.

surface_after.name: task__create
surface_after.description: Create a pending task with a saved Scheme validation program. Choose a unique taskId; the tool returns that ID. Creation captures the program without running its checks. When the work is ready, call task__start and then task__validate with that ID. The saved program cannot be replaced; drop the task and create a new ID if its checks need correction.

description.description: Task requirements and scope; the validation program must check these requirements.

activeForm.description: Progress label displayed while this task is active.

activationBrief.description: Instructions to follow when this task becomes active.

validationProgram.description: Scheme source text, saved now and evaluated later by task__validate in a fresh scope. Use Scheme calls such as (read_file "path") for file text, (equal? actual expected) for comparison, and (tasks/write-completion-verdict ok "evidence") for the final verdict. Available project ports: read_file, list_dir, grep, glob, fff_search, shell. Paths resolve from the project root. Adapt this example to the task's actual requirements: (tasks/write-completion-verdict (equal? (read_file "status.txt") "ready") "status.txt must contain exactly ready"). The outer argument is a JSON string; its contents use Scheme syntax. Returning #t alone does not record a verdict.

taskId.description: A nonempty unique ID you choose, such as remove-picker. Reuse this ID with task__start, task__validate, task__after, and task__drop.

surface_after.name: task__start
surface_after.description: Make a pending task active before working on it or calling task__validate. Returns its subject and activationBrief. Only one task is active at a time; starting another returns the previous task to pending. Starting the active task changes nothing.

taskId.description: ID of an existing pending or active task.

surface_after.name: task__drop
surface_after.description: Abandon an unfinished task and save the reason. Use this when its scope or saved Scheme validation program needs replacement, then task__create with a new ID. Completed tasks cannot be dropped; dropping an already-dropped task changes nothing. Returns false as an acknowledgement on success.

taskId.description: ID of the unfinished task to drop.

reason.description: Why this task is being abandoned or replaced; saved with the task.

surface_after.name: task__after
surface_after.description: Record that taskId depends on the task named by after. Both tasks must already exist. This records the prerequisite for planning; it does not start tasks or block task__start. Returns false as an acknowledgement on success.

surface_after.name: task__validate
surface_after.description: Run the active task's saved Scheme validation program against current project state. Call task__start first. The program must finish with (tasks/write-completion-verdict ok comments); the tool returns that boolean/string pair. A true verdict completes the task; a false verdict returns it to pending so you can fix the work, start it, and validate again. To correct the saved program itself, drop the task and create a new ID.

taskId.description: ID of the active task whose saved Scheme program should run.
